title: Secret Nazi Ruins

A labyrinth of tunnels carved deep in the Polish mountains leads to the largest underground Nazi weapons development complex ever discovered.

title: Secret Nazi Ruins
description:

The skeletal remains of strange structures are clues to a mysterious research installation secretly built by the Nazis in Western Poland; experts investigate and uncover top-secret military fuel development with a catastrophic purpose.

When the Nazis took Ksiaz Castle in 1941, it wasn't for the view, and they got to work turning it into a fortress; secret staircases and elevators were built, while underneath, a vast network of tunnels was taking form.

A medieval castle-like complex in the remote mountains of Germany contains dark secrets to the Nazi's plan for world domination; experts investigate and uncover a nefarious training facility designed to groom elite Nazi personnel.

title: Engineering Catastrophes
description:
S06 E09 — California Flood Fiasco
A perfect storm with tragic consequences strikes as floodwaters rip away a major highway crossing in Huron, Calif.; experts use the latest tech to investigate and reveal bridge scouring with unsupported concrete columns exposed for failure.

title: Engineering Catastrophes
description:
S07 E03 — Tower Crane Calamity
A crane collapse leaves seven dead on a holiday weekend in Manhattan; an investigation reveals how a shortcut taken while raising the crane left the machine swaying in the wind without proper lateral support.

title: Engineering Catastrophes
description:
S06 E08 — Quake of Christchurch
Tragedy strikes the heart of a city as an earthquake wipes out a building full of people in Christchurch, New Zealand; experts investigate an inadequate structural design and weakness in critical supporting columns.

title: Engineering Catastrophes
description:
S07 E01 — Pacific Coast Bridge Collapse
Residents along the Pacific Coast Highway are cut off from the outside world after a storm causes a bridge to buckle; experts reveal how the construction method of the old concrete bridge left it vulnerable to erosion on the steep coastline.

title: Engineering Catastrophes
description:
S07 E02 — Island Observatory Failure
In Puerto Rico, an iconic observatory nestled into a giant crater has to close after cables holding up a critical platform come crashing down; experts analyze the cumulative effects that led to the collapse of this awe-inspiring structure.

title: Engineering Catastrophes
description:
S07 E04 — The Fern Hollow Fiasco
On a snowy morning in Pittsburgh, a messy commute becomes dangerous after a bridge collapses; an investigation reveals how corrosion and other environmental factors helped bring down this decades-old structure.

title: Engineering Catastrophes
description:
S06 E07 — Blaze of Winston-Salem
A catastrophic fire at a fertilizer plant threatens city-wide devastation in Winston-Salem, N.C.; experts use the latest science to investigate an outdated, wooden storage facility heavily stocked with volatile, explosive chemicals.

title: Fatal Engineering
description:
S01 E06 — Nuclear Plant Disasters
Hunt for the root cause of atomic accidents; examine the Windscale fire, which led to safer reactor designs; learn why swift crisis management helped in the Three Mile Island incident; see why improper waste disposal fuelled the Kyshtym disaster.

title: Fatal Engineering
description:
S01 E02 — Bridge Collapses
Bridge collapses have etched hard lessons into the history of engineering; Tacoma, Minneapolis, Genoa, symbols of innovation that have become stark reminders of what happens when flaws go unchecked.

title: Fatal Engineering
description:
S01 E03 — Dam Collapses
When dams break, devastation follows; Derna, Malpasset, Brumadinho, three disasters that turned engineering failures into mass tragedies.

title: Fatal Engineering
description:
S01 E05 — Skyscraper Collapses
Pinpoint the mistakes that cause major structural failures; explore the preventable explosion inside London's Ronan Point; the code violations that collapsed Lalita Park; the short circuit that set off a deadly fire in Tehran's Plasco Building.

title: Fatal Engineering
description:
S01 E04 — Rollercoaster Accidents
Drill down on maintenance and safety lapses that derailed amusement park rides.

title: Fatal Engineering

description:

The ancient necropolis of Abusir contains strange megastructures unlike any discovered in Egypt; experts gain rare access to investigate lost tombs and forgotten rituals to reveal the secrets of Egypt's Sun Cult pharaohs.

title: Unearthed
description:
S10 E04 — Secrets of Hadrian's Villa
Hadrian's Villa is the largest Roman palace ever constructed and demonstrates the opulent peak of Rome's ancient engineering; experts investigate secrets that could reveal the truth behind one of Rome's most enigmatic emperors.

title: Unearthed
description:

The magnificent tomb of Alexander the Great mysteriously vanishes and becomes a legend; using CGI, investigators piece together the evidence to reveal where his tomb lies and what it might look like.

The Red Pyramid at Dahshur is a revolutionary megastructure and the first true pyramid ever constructed in Ancient Egypt; experts investigate to reveal the pharaoh who built it and the mystery behind its trailblazing design.

title: Unearthed
description:

In 373 B.C., the Greek city of Helike vanished; archaeologists believe they've found the ruins of the great lost metropolis; using CGI, experts re-create the city's final moments and reveal its links to the greatest lost land of all -- Atlantis.

description:
S06 E04 — Pluto's Evil Twin
After NASA's New Horizons spacecraft flies by Pluto, it encounters a strange alien world that shuts down the probe's computers; experts investigate if the mysterious object is an alien spacecraft hiding at the edge of the solar system.

title: NASA's Unexplained Files
description:
S06 E08 — Did Aliens Nuke Mars?
A strange discovery by NASA's Mars Curiosity rover suggests the Red Planet was home to an alien nuclear war 300 million years ago; experts investigate if an extraterrestrial Armageddon transformed an Earth-like world into a wasteland.

title: How the Universe Works
description:
S10 E01 — Secrets of the Cosmic Web
New astronomical research is beginning to reveal an invisible scaffold of dark matter known as the Cosmic Web, an intergalactic network that transformed the universe from a chaotic Big Bang into the structured beauty of the present day cosmos.

title: How the Universe Works
description:
S10 E02 — Curse of the Cosmic Rays
Cosmic rays capable of destroying human DNA are hurtling through outer space like subatomic bullets, causing space crews radiation damage.

Stel and Jess dig into unexplored archeological sites along the Adriatic coast of Croatia where underwater relics from an ancient bridge system lead them to an age-old legend of a lost city and into a massive sinkhole that could swallow a city whole.

title: Hunting Atlantis

Stel and Jess sail to Sicily to explore Europe's largest active volcano; their investigation leads them to a hidden labyrinth and a mysterious underwater monolith.

Stel and Jess investigate cave paintings in Turkey that match an advanced civilization that built the world's oldest city; tracing the ancient migration to the coast, they discover a shoreline and ruins of a lost city right under their feet.

title: Secrets of the Lost Ark
description:
S01 E01 — Buried Beneath Jerusalem
Lost for centuries, scholars believe the Ark of the Covenant never left Jerusalem and remains buried beneath this ancient city; now, a pioneering team of archaeologists is on a quest to unearth the most famous and treasured artifact in human history.

title: Secrets of the Lost Ark
description:
S01 E02 — Heist in the Holy Land
Ancient documents and legends suggest that the Ark of the Covenant may have been stolen by Roman legions and hidden in Rome; a team of archaeologists explores mystery cults and ancient catacombs to uncover the truth behind this treasured artifact.

title: Secrets of the Lost Ark
description:
S01 E06 — The Doomsday Curse
Ancient scriptures describe the Ark of the Covenant as possessing an almighty force with the capacity to kill; now, an expert team of archaeologists traces the ark's destructive path in a quest to discover the truth behind its mythical power.

title: Secrets of the Lost Ark
description:
S01 E04 — The Jeremiah Code
According to biblical scripture, the prophet Jeremiah hides the Ark of the Covenant at a remote location for safekeeping; a team of archaeologists investigates sacred sites and ancient tombs to retrace the possible journey of this lost artifact.

title: Secrets of the Lost Ark
description:
S01 E05 — Legend of the Knights Templar
The holy order of the Knights Templar are believed to have located and seized the Ark of the Covenant centuries ago; now, expert historians follow the trail of this elusive order to uncover the truth behind this sacred relic's mysterious journey.

title: Secrets of the Lost Ark
description:
S01 E07 — Mysteries of Ethiopia's Ark
Some allege that the Ark of the Covenant was stolen by King Solomon's son and taken to Ethiopia thousands of years ago; now, archaeologists investigate new, mysterious leads to uncover the secrets behind this lost relic's elusive journey.
